name: claude-builders-bounty
description: Issue #521 README bounty link validation — npm test runs tests/run-ci-checks.sh (python3 unittest, no node deps).

scripts.test:readme-links: bash -c 'readme_link_tests=$(grep -Ec "^[[:space:]]*def test_" tests/test_readme_links.py); python3 -m unittest tests/test_readme_links.py -v; echo "Ran ${readme_link_tests} README link tests — OK"'
scripts.test:peer-review: bash -c 'peer_review_tests=$(grep -Ec "^[[:space:]]*def test_" tests/test_peer_review_acceptance.py); python3 -m unittest tests/test_peer_review_acceptance.py -v; echo "Ran ${peer_review_tests} peer review acceptance tests — OK"; echo "OK: peer review acceptance tests passed"'
scripts.test:delivery: bash -c 'delivery_tests=$(grep -Ec "^[[:space:]]*def test_" tests/test_delivery_verification.py); README_CI_INNER_RUN=1 python3 -m unittest tests/test_delivery_verification.py -v; echo "Ran ${delivery_tests} delivery verification tests — OK"; echo "OK: delivery verification tests passed"'
